description: After adding or importing picks, fetch their enriched preview here. If preparing, call again after retryAfterMs. If a Curated review card is showing, it carries the picks and the one confirmation: do not list them again. Otherwise show the returned preview as written and ask once if it looks good. Keep reviewId and itemRefs internal. Omit IDs, positions, confidence scores and provenance commentary. No app visit or later list update is needed. An unfinished preview survives reconnecting.
